items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer lists 'Cubie' among drummers the interviewee has been involved with, but Interviewee does not confirm or elaborate on this specific connection in the provided text.

ctx.x: Well, you were there, and besides that in all the annals of history, you are without a doubt the only white drummer that came up, because you knew all of these people that you have been involved with because of the association -- how you got from this town in the New England states to Kansas City is a miracle, through Dan Murphy in Boston, which is as different as night and day. And here you are, in all of the annals of drumming, all the great drummers of the jazz era -- you, Cliff Leeman, have bridged the…

considered a black art, you have been around longer and before most of them have been involved with most black artists and most black performers, and you have been involved with Basie, in Kansas City with Dave Tough, Jo Jones, Gene Austin Jim Krupa, with Baby Dodds, Buddy Rich and Cubie? -- Sid Catlett these are -- and Big . So here you are -- your name ranks high among all the other drummers that I just named, and I'm certain that there are more that you can tell me about, because I can't tell you about your…
